topicA: AI Search Visibility and Brand Discovery

recap.intro: This week you explored two exciting areas of B2B marketing: how AI is changing search visibility and the power of Account-Based Marketing.
bullets: Many business buyers now start their research with AI chatbots, which often influence them to choose different companies than they initially planned.
Account-Based Marketing (ABM) focuses on treating each high-value company as its own unique market, tailoring everything specifically for them.
Marketing and sales teams must work together more closely than ever, sharing goals and using precise data, to achieve significant growth and larger deals.
While big brands often dominate AI search for direct purchases, smaller businesses can find opportunities by providing unique content for 'inspiration' searches.
recap.closing: This week you learned that adapting to new technologies and aligning your teams are crucial for effectively reaching today's B2B buyers.
